items.text: Incorporated round 3 decisions: (d1) batch_handler.go decomposition via named functions in same file, (d2) phase-based ordering confirmed, (d3) no agent commits — user handles manually, (d4) no numeric score target — success is all 30 files addressed + tech debt removed.
Fixed validation gaps: added Greenfield Declaration section near top of plan, added `vrooli scenario restart swarm-manager` as final cleanup step in Phase 5 and Definition of Done.

Updated Definition of Done and Target End State to remove numeric score targets (was >=50), replacing with 'all 30 files refactored per specified actions'. Commit prohibition added to Contract Decisions and Non-goals sections.
All 12 settled decisions from rounds 1-3 are reflected in the plan. No remaining gaps identified — plan is ready for execution.
